model_scope: Population synthesis of isolated magnetic-dipole pulsar tracks and binary recycled pulsar tracks in spin period, period derivative, magnetic inclination, surface magnetic field, and braking index space, with statistical comparison to timing survey observables.

parameter_requests.meaning: Gravitational mass of the neutron star used in spin-down inertia and accretion torque calculations.
required_conditions: degenerate neutron-star matter equation of state
retrieval_queries: neutron star mass measurements for isolated pulsars under radio timing survey conditions
neutron star mass constraints for recycled pulsars under disk accretion and magnetospheric boundary conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Neutron star radius entering dipole torque geometry and accretion torque scaling.
retrieval_queries: neutron star radius constraints from thermal surface emission under isolated neutron star conditions
neutron star radius constraints from X-ray burst oscillations under accretion disk pressure conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Fixed neutron star moment of inertia used to convert torque into spin evolution.
required_conditions: fixed moment of inertia along each track
neutron star equation of state composition
retrieval_queries: moment of inertia constraints from neutron star mass and radius measurements under equation of state conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Scalar normalization for the vacuum magnetic-dipole torque law under assumed spherical dipole geometry.
retrieval_queries: reference conventions for vacuum magnetic dipole torque normalization under spherical dipole geometry and isolated pulsar boundary conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Initial efficiency factor multiplying wind braking torque in isolated pulsar spin-down.
retrieval_queries: wind braking efficiency estimates for isolated pulsars under magnetic dipole spin-down conditions
wind torque normalization from pulsar timing surveys under high-precision geometry conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Timescale for variation of wind braking efficiency during isolated spin-down.
retrieval_queries: wind braking efficiency evolution timescale for isolated pulsars under magnetic inclination decay conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Decay timescale for magnetic inclination angle in isolated pulsar spin-down.
retrieval_queries: magnetic inclination angle decay timescale from pulsar timing residuals under isolated dipole evolution conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Initial magnetic inclination angle for a simulated pulsar track.
retrieval_queries: magnetic inclination angle distribution for young pulsars under radio timing geometry conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Mean spin period of the birth period distribution used to sample isolated pulsar initial conditions.
retrieval_queries: birth spin period distribution for isolated pulsars under supernova formation conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Logarithmic dispersion of the birth spin period distribution.
retrieval_queries: dispersion of birth spin period distribution under pulsar formation conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Mean surface dipole magnetic field of the birth field distribution.
retrieval_queries: surface dipole magnetic field distribution for young pulsars under vacuum dipole spin-down conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Logarithmic dispersion of the birth surface dipole magnetic field distribution.
retrieval_queries: dispersion of surface dipole magnetic field distribution for young pulsars under spin-down conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Timescale for surface magnetic field decay during isolated spin-down.
retrieval_queries: surface magnetic field decay timescale for pulsars under dipole spin-down and thermal surface conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Scalar coefficient setting the magnitude of the disk accretion torque during recycling.
retrieval_queries: accretion torque coefficient estimates from disk accretion theory for recycled pulsars under magnetospheric boundary conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Mass accretion rate applied during the recycling phase.
retrieval_queries: accretion rate distributions for low-mass X-ray binaries under disk accretion conditions
accretion rate measurements for recycled pulsar progenitors under binary evolution conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Duration of the accretion phase before isolated spin-down resumes.
retrieval_queries: accretion episode durations for recycled pulsar formation under binary evolution conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Minimum observable period derivative used to terminate simulated tracks.
required_conditions: radio or X-ray pulsar geometry conditions
retrieval_queries: period derivative detection threshold for high-precision pulsar timing surveys under radio sensitivity conditions
period derivative sensitivity limits for X-ray timing surveys under accretion pulsar conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Maximum age used to terminate simulated tracks.
retrieval_queries: maximum age boundary conventions for pulsar population synthesis under detector sensitivity conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Switch controlling whether magnetic inclination decay is included in a simulated track.
retrieval_queries: model assumption conventions for enabling or disabling inclination decay in pulsar spin-down population synthesis

parameter_requests.meaning: Switch controlling whether wind braking torque is included in a simulated track.
retrieval_queries: model assumption conventions for enabling or disabling wind braking in pulsar spin-down population synthesis

parameter_requests.meaning: Switch controlling whether a binary recycling accretion phase is included in a simulated track.
retrieval_queries: model assumption conventions for enabling or disabling accretion phases in pulsar population synthesis

parameter_requests.meaning: Number of Monte Carlo pulsar tracks generated for population comparison.
retrieval_queries: Monte Carlo sample size conventions for pulsar population synthesis under statistical comparison conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Deterministic seed controlling Monte Carlo initial-condition and history sampling.
retrieval_queries: random seed reproducibility conventions for Monte Carlo pulsar population synthesis

parameter_requests.meaning: Requested integration tolerance for spin-down ODE tracks.
retrieval_queries: ODE integration tolerance conventions for pulsar spin-down tracks under high-precision timing comparison conditions

parameter_requests.meaning: Threshold used to decide whether simulated scenario distributions are statistically separable.
retrieval_queries: statistical significance conventions for separating pulsar population scenarios under timing survey comparison conditions

scientific_question: Can the joint distribution of braking index n and characteristic age tau_c statistically distinguish isolated magnetic-dipole evolution from binary recycling populations, given specific torque model constraints?
symbolic_constraints: The model assumes a fixed neutron-star moment of inertia along each simulated track.
The model assumes vacuum magnetic-dipole torque as the base isolated spin-down mechanism.
The model assumes optional wind braking and optional inclination decay are controlled by scenario switches.
The model assumes optional binary recycling accretion torque is active only during the requested accretion phase duration.
The model assumes surface magnetic field evolution, when included, is governed by a single decay timescale.
The model derives period derivative and braking index from integrated spin tracks rather than imposing numerical prior values.
The model terminates tracks at the requested period-derivative detection threshold or maximum simulated age.
The model excludes glitches, magnetospheric state changes, companion ablation, and observational selection effects unless explicitly added.
The model uses Monte Carlo sampling of birth period, birth magnetic field, and initial inclination distributions for population synthesis.
symbolic_model_intent: Use ODE initial-value integration to evolve spin period, magnetic inclination, and surface magnetic field under dipole, wind, and accretion torque terms; derive period derivative and braking index diagnostics; use Monte Carlo sampling of initial conditions and accretion histories to generate population distributions.
title: Distinguishing Isolated Dipole Evolution from Binary Recycling via Braking Index and Period Derivative Correlations
